All green — submitting iteration 16.

**What changed**
- `app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx` — replaced the plain gradient with the spec's "full-bleed poster collage": 30 real catalog posters in a full-screen grid, darkened with gradient overlays so the headline and email form stay legible.
- `app/frontend/src/components/TitleModal.jsx` — the title-detail modal now has the spec-required **Play / + (My List) / thumbs** control row next to the large title: the + button does a real per-profile list add/remove (toggles to ✓), and the thumbs button opens the real rate dialog.
- Verified all 125 seeded asset paths (posters/backdrops/clips) exist in the frontend bundle; re-ran build + `no-undef` lint (clean) and the full `validate` (14/14 smoke, 15/15 contract 2xx, 8/8 chain).

**Still minor / by design**
- No cast data in the dataset, so the modal omits cast (honest).
- Browse-by-languages keeps a single "Original Language" dropdown — the dataset has one language per title, so Dubbing/Subtitles tabs would be fabricated.
- Player subtitle/audio picks are local UI state (no track files shipped).

Everything else (auth, per-profile data, rails, player, top-10, search, rate dialog, account menu) is wired to real endpoints and unchanged from the passing version.
